questions.standard_level: Geometry. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Geometry, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.prompt: In triangle ABC, the altitude from A to side CB has length h. Derive the formula Area = ½ab sin C.
questions.prompt_markup: In triangle ABC, the altitude from A to side CB has length h. Derive the formula Area = ½ab sin C.
questions.correct_answer: h = b sin C, so Area = ½ah = ½ab sin C.
questions.required_method: Express h using sin C in right triangle ADC, then use Area = ½ · base · height.
questions.grading_note: Any valid proof (paragraph, two-column, or flow). Essential: in right triangle ADC, sin C = h/b, so h = b sin C; Area = ½ · a · h; substitute. Alternative: an altitude from B gives the same result with h = a sin C.
